NXP I2C-bus specification UM10204, Standard-mode tr<=1000ns, Fast-mode tr<=300ns (30%-70% VDD): https://www.nxp.com/docs/en/user-guide/UM10204.pdf

notes: FINDING: with the BOM 4.7k pull-ups and 100 pF bus capacitance, tr(30-70%) ~398 ns > 300 ns -> the intended 400 kHz I2C does NOT meet Fast-mode timing. 200 pF is even worse (~796 ns). Standard-mode 100 kHz passes (<=1000 ns) for all tested cases. Recommendations: (a) run the OLED at 100 kHz, or (b) change R3/R4 to 2.2k (186 ns @100pF; still 373 ns @200pF -> keep bus cap <= ~150 pF and verify with scope). I2C bus capacitance is an ASSUMPTION (module + traces); measure it.
